minecraft:diamond.answer: Look for diamond ore deep underground in the Overworld, below Y=16. It becomes more common toward the bottom of the world; around Y=-59 is a useful mining level, but watch for lava. Use an iron pickaxe or better to collect diamonds. They are not restricted to one Overworld biome.
conditions: Normal modern terrain generation; previously generated chunks may differ.
Ore distribution is not a guaranteed position.
Silk Touch is required to collect the ore block itself; resource drops and intact ore are different.

minecraft:coal.answer: Look for coal ore above Y=0 in the Overworld. It generates up to Y=320, with an underground concentration around Y=96; exposed hills and mountains are useful places to search. Bedrock also has an extra mountain batch from Y=128 to Y=256. Use a wooden pickaxe or better. For fuel, smelting logs into charcoal is another option.

minecraft:raw_iron.answer: Look for iron ore in the Overworld. Around Y=16 is a useful underground level; tall mountains are another good place, with a high-altitude concentration around Y=232 where terrain exists. Large underground iron veins can occur in deepslate. Use a stone pickaxe or better, then smelt the raw iron into ingots.

minecraft:raw_copper.answer: Copper ore generates in the Overworld from Y=-16 to Y=112, most often around Y=47 or Y=48. Dripstone caves have larger copper deposits. Use a stone pickaxe or better and smelt the raw copper into ingots.

minecraft:raw_gold.answer: For Overworld gold ore, search underground around Y=-16 using an iron pickaxe or better, then smelt the raw gold. Normal underground batches extend from Y=-64 to Y=32. Badlands have an extra gold batch from Y=32 to Y=256. Nether gold ore is a separate source with different mining requirements.

minecraft:emerald.answer: Emerald ore generates in mountain and windswept hill biomes, including meadows, cherry groves, groves, snowy slopes and the mountain peaks. Its range is Y=-16 to Y=320. Higher mountain rock is worth searching; the generation distribution peaks around Y=232, but there must be terrain there. Use an iron pickaxe or better. Trading with villagers is another way to obtain emeralds.

minecraft:ancient_debris.answer: Ancient debris is found in the Nether. Search inside netherrack around Y=16 and use a diamond or netherite pickaxe. Bedrock has generation batches from Y=8 to Y=23 and from Y=8 to Y=119. It normally generates buried rather than open to air. Watch for lava; smelt ancient debris into netherite scrap.
